articles.title: SEPI paid Grant Thornton 479,160 euros to filter its emails in the face of its legal battles
articles.excerpt: The contract, awarded without a public tender, covers document review across several ongoing proceedings.
articles.author: marta-ibanez
articles.imageCaption: The state holding company's headquarters | EP
content: The state holding company paid an outside firm 479,160 euros to filter and review internal emails as part of its response to several ongoing legal proceedings, according to documents reviewed by this outlet.
The contract, awarded without a full public tender, covers document review across multiple cases currently before the courts.
Opposition lawmakers have requested further detail on the scope of the work and the criteria used to select the firm.

articles.title: A threat of vetoes and embargoes on 'made in Spain' products that Botin will avoid thanks to his close relationship with Trump
articles.excerpt: In July, the US president ordered the creation of a list of Spanish products. Washington is tightening its tariffs after the Supreme Court's setback.
articles.author: marta-ibanez
articles.imageCaption: A commercial aircraft on the tarmac | EP
content: The US administration ordered the creation of a list of Spanish products subject to new tariffs in July, part of a broader tightening of trade measures following a setback at the Supreme Court.
Legal analysts say a small number of firms with strong personal ties to the administration are likely to be shielded from the most severe measures, at least in the short term.
Trade lawyers are advising affected exporters to review their contracts for tariff-adjustment clauses ahead of the list's expected publication.

articles.title: High Court ruling narrows how companies can share customer data with third parties
articles.excerpt: The decision is expected to force several sectors to revisit their data-sharing agreements before year end.
articles.author: marta-ibanez
content: A High Court ruling has narrowed the circumstances under which companies can share customer data with third-party partners without fresh, explicit consent.
Legal advisers say the decision is likely to force several sectors, particularly retail and telecoms, to revisit existing data-sharing agreements before the end of the year.
Industry groups have asked for a transition period, warning that renegotiating contracts at short notice would be costly for smaller firms.

articles.title: Regulators step up enforcement of the whistleblower protection law two years in
articles.excerpt: The agency has opened a record number of inquiries into retaliation complaints this year.
articles.author: marta-ibanez
content: Regulators have opened a record number of inquiries into retaliation complaints under the whistleblower protection law, two years after it came into force.
The increase follows a series of awareness campaigns aimed at employees in both public and private sectors, according to the enforcement agency's latest figures.
Employment lawyers say companies are increasingly seeking compliance reviews of their internal reporting channels to avoid falling foul of the law.
